column3: NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1. Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew; “make glory His praise” is rendered “Make His praise glorious.”
“They cringe before You” is rendered “will give feigned obedience to You”; NASB continues the quotation through verse 4.
Close to the Hebrew; “bow down” is rendered “worship.”
Close to the Hebrew; “affliction” is rendered “an oppressive burden,” and “hips” as “loins.”
Close to the Hebrew; “to the superfluity” is rendered “into a place of abundance.”
“Exaltation was under my tongue” is rendered “He was extolled with my tongue.”
